project_name: OC Corrections FDC Isolation Cell Renovations Units F & G, Orlando FL
scope_of_work_and_exclusions: DEMOLITION SCOPE OF WORK
Remove existing detention plumbing fixtures and all accessories - 16 WC, 16 lavatories, 2 combination fixtures (Plan Note D07, Plumbing Note 1)
Remove existing restroom / shower partitions and shower drains, Units F & G (Plan Note D04, Plumbing Note 3)
Remove existing plaster ceilings in hatched areas incl. security mesh where present, +/-1,065 SF (Plan Legend, RFI #29)
Remove existing door, frame and all accessories, Unit F, 1 EA (Plan Note D09)
Remove all above-slab sanitary and vent piping in hatched areas incl. 4" sanitary line up to and including the 4" VTR, Units F & G (Plumbing Notes 1, 5)

Remove all domestic plumbing in chases and walls incl. valves, fixtures and associated controls, surface-mounted stainless steel pipe enclosures in their entirety, and the existing valve control cabinet (Plumbing Notes 1, 2, 3)
Remove existing AHUs and portions of supply and outdoor air ductwork as required for new AHUs, 2 EA (Mech Note 2, Elec Note 2)
Remove existing RTUs and return duct transitions after chilled water and condensate piping are disconnected by mechanical, 2 EA (Mech Note 2)
Remove existing roof exhaust and supply fans, curbs and security bars to remain, 4 EA (Mech Notes 1, 2, 3)
Remove existing supply / return grilles and associated ductwork, hangers, straps and supports, incl. 12x12 exhaust duct to 2nd floor (Mech Notes 1, 7, 9)
Remove 2" CHWS&R piping back to 3" reducer, supports to remain, Unit G (Mech Note 3)
Remove sprinkler branch piping and heads shown for demolition, +/-360 LF, after drain-down by the fire protection contractor (FPD111, FPD112)
Remove existing light fixtures, 80 EA (ED111F/G, ED112F/G)
Remove AHU and exhaust fan disconnect switches, devices, cabling and conduit back to the nearest junction box, after make-safe by electrician (Elec Notes 1, 2; ED113F/G Note 1)
Remove existing fire alarm devices shown for demolition, 24 EA (FAD111F/G, FAD112F/G)
Carry all debris down from Level 2 by stair (no elevator), haul out nightly; account for all tools and debris at end of each shift per Corrections requirements (RFI #40, #43; Spec 01 1100 1.9)
Provide tacky mats, poly at openings and HEPA vacuums; leave work areas broom clean at the end of each shift (Spec 02 4113 1.4.G; Gen. Note W)
Legally dispose of all demolition debris off-site; owner retains first right of refusal on salvage per joint damage survey (Gen. Notes D, L; Spec 02 4113 3.5)
ALTERNATES

ALTERNATE #1: Remove 8" solid grouted CMU chase walls - Level 1 +/-166 LF (+/-1,770 SF) and Level 2 +/-62 LF (+/-560 SF); cut dowels flush where slab remains, following EOR field review (Struct Notes 1, 4; Plan Notes D01, D02)
ALTERNATE #2: Sawcut and remove 4" slab-on-grade, thickened slab, footings and continuous bars, Unit F +/-555 SF / Unit G +/-569 SF (Struct Note 3; Plan Notes D11, D13; SD501 A4, A6)

ALTERNATE #3: Wall / slab cuts for new plumbing 9 EA, partial wall demo for new door 1 EA, 12" openings in precast wall panels 4 EA, precast mezzanine slab openings 2 EA, roof panel / metal deck openings 3 EA, incl. GPR / X-ray scanning allowance (Plan Notes D03, D10; SD112F/G, SD121, SD501; RFI #32)
ALTERNATE #4: Grind dowels / wall base down 1/2" minimum below top of slab where slab remains (Struct Note 4)
ALTERNATE #5: Negative air machines and full-height poly dust containment, Units F & G
ALTERNATE #6: Daytime work (Spec 01 2300 Alternate No. 1) - DDD price unchanged (flat labor rate)
EXCLUSIONS
- All patching, repair, slab repair per specs, roof patching, curbs and caps, fireproofing repair, and prep for new finishes (Spec 01 7329; Mech Note 2; RFI #21)
- Excavation, trenching and backfill below slab; disconnecting / capping / grout-abandoning underslab and below-grade piping (Plumbing Notes 2, 4, 5)
- Disconnect, cap and make-safe of all utilities - electrical, plumbing, chilled water, sprinkler drain-down and impairment, and fire alarm system programming / bypass by the respective trades
- Removal of conduit and wiring beyond the nearest junction box or back to the panel / source (Elec Gen. Note 4)

- Shoring: included is limited to non-load-bearing masonry; load-bearing wall shoring, shoring design, structural engineering, PE survey and stamped drawings excluded (RFI #46; Spec 02 4113 3.1.C; S001)
- Furnishing / installing lintels, bearing plates, jamb reinforcement, security bars at penetrations, and grouting (RFI #76)
- Plywood / steel security covers at openings left overnight, temporary partitions and guardrails by GC (01 1100 1.9)
- Hazardous materials (asbestos, lead, PCB ballasts) identification, abatement or disposal - no survey provided
- Crane or rooftop rigging for RTUs / fans; detention equipment and security systems (RFI #79, #82)
- Domestic Water Piping Replacement project (FDC_DW drawings) and ACT grid / tile removal and replacement
- Items to remain: existing fixtures to remain (Plumbing Note 6), existing lights in dayroom, equipment within NIC rooms, roof curbs and security bars
TERMS
- Bid based on plans and specifications only; quantities scaled and +/- (field verify).
- Zero retainage; net 30; price valid 90 days.
- Mobilization not included in unit pricing; each additional mobilization (e.g., Unit F and Unit G phased separately) $3,250.
- Night work Mon-Fri included at no premium; weekend work only with Corrections' written approval.
- Security time, escorts and FDLE background checks for DDD crew included as listed; delays from inmate movement, lockdowns or denied access are by change order.
